definition: Karin M Verspoor or Cornelia Verspoor is a researcher in AI and Health Technologies, at RMIT, a Fellow of the Australian Academy of Technology and Engineering (ATSE), and a Fellow of the Australasian Institute of Digital Health.
details: Professor Verspoor was the executive dean of RMIT School of Computing, and researches ChatGPT, generative AI and digital health, applying AI methods to interpret clinical and biological data. She was Dean of the School of Computing Technologies at RMIT as at 2025.
